# Banyan Tree Residences Hillside

> Banyan Tree Residences Hillside Dubai is a 130-metre branded residential tower in Jumeirah Lakes Towers, rising 32 storeys above two basement levels on an elevated plot overlooking Emirates Golf Club. It holds 235 homes ranging from studios to four-bedroom apartments, penthouses and duplexes across roughly 53,000 square metres. Residents have use of a Banyan Tree spa, a 31-metre pool, a fitness centre and concierge services.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed
- Year: 2020

## MENASCO Scope

Banyan Tree Residences Hillside Dubai is a 130-metre branded residential tower in Jumeirah Lake Towers, developed by Sweid & Sweid in partnership with Banyan Tree and designed by Brewer Smith Brewer Group. Rising 31 floors above two basement levels, it overlooks the Emirates Golf Club and offers resort-style amenities including a spa and a 31-metre pool. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the tower.
